The final answer is usually one part of the transcript. The outcome is the real task result.", "locator": null}], "confidence": 1.0}, {"concept": "Grader", "summary": "A grader turns evidence into judgment by inspecting outcome, trajectory, tool use, costs, policy compliance, and quality dimensions.", "evidence": [{"quote": "A grader turns evidence into judgment.
